# Quantitative Sociology & Mixed-Methods Research

Hello, I’m **Moustafa Basiony**, a quantitative sociologist and mixed-methods researcher who recently completed an MSc in Sociology, Culture and Society at KU Leuven.

My research focuses on **discrimination, social inequality, migration, and intergroup relations**. I use survey research, statistical modelling, and computational methods to study how social experiences and contexts shape attitudes, inequalities, and intergroup relations.

:::

::: {.callout-note}

## Methods at a glance

Survey research · logistic & ordinal regression · interaction & moderation analysis · reproducible R workflows · computational text analysis · web scraping

:::

## Featured projects

:::: {.projects-grid}

::: {.project-card}

### Master’s Thesis: Acceptance of Ethnic and Religious Discrimination among Adolescents

I conducted an independent quantitative study using survey data from 762 students in Dutch-language Belgian secondary schools to examine how intergroup contact, perceived and vicarious discrimination, and migrant background relate to acceptance of ethnic and religious discrimination.

[View project](projects/thesis-discrimination.qmd)

:::

::: {.project-card}

### Detecting Gender-Based Hate Speech on Reddit

I used R, text analysis, and supervised machine learning to classify hate speech in Reddit posts and examine patterns in the detected content.

[View project](projects/hate-speech.qmd)

:::

::: {.project-card}

### Predicting Loneliness from Survey Data

I used PCA, clustering, and machine-learning models to explore survey patterns and evaluate how effectively loneliness could be identified.

[View project](projects/survey-machine-learning.qmd)

:::
